changes.name: decouple-skills-from-dev-assets
changes.one_line_scope: Promote the two downstream-live conformance guards to skill scripts, rewrite the mutation gate in lite-pr 2b and revise.md 2b as prose, and rename both aggregate.py — all in place, no file moves.

changes.name: extract-dev-tree-from-plugin
changes.one_line_scope: Move every dev-only asset out of the published plugin tree into <repo>/plugin-tests/ as one pytest scope, relocate the release skill to <repo>/.claude/skills/release/, delete run_tests.py and the SOURCE-REPO-ONLY markers, add the release-time shipped-tree scan, and reconcile the docs.

plan_amendments.what: Q6's three-change split became two: guard-shipped-asset-boundary was folded into extract-dev-tree-from-plugin and its directory deleted.
plan_amendments.why: The Phase 4 batch review found that .claude/plugins/cla/consistency-checks/tests/test_doc_facts.py enforces doc/code agreement — stated pytest-scope counts, skills-shipping-tests counts, the root README skill count, and test_no_doc_names_a_plugin_path_that_no_longer_exists. Moving the tree while deferring every doc fix to a later change lands the relocating change with its own bare-pytest gate red, by construction. The two are one atomic unit; the decisions file's Q6 rationale (each change reviewable in its own diff mode) does not survive contact with that guard.
plan_amendments.decided_by: user, in session, after the review reported it
